'''2007 Worlds Team Ryan Mason DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Mason]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Deck title Team Brad Hay. Heavy Imperial Propaganda (V) / Emperor suite.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ryan Mason]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Let Them Make The First Move / At Peace|Let Them Make The First Move]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
